items.q: Big-Eye Louis [Nelson] was a great clarinet player, who was somewhat of a rival of Tio.

ctx.x: Big-Eye Louis [Nelson] was a great clarinet player, who was somewhat of a rival of Tio. Big-Eye Louis and Picou, they were masters of that style of playing, that improvisation...
Was Jay-Joe(?) from here? A clarinet player named Jay-Joe(?).
